deck_name: Deck Supreme 60 — Teal Mask Ogerpon ex / Turbo Acceleration & Psychic Counter Hybrid
archetype: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex / Grass Turbo Ramp / Anti-Meta Control

card_list.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex
card_list.role: Primary Attacker & Grass Engine (Teal Dance energy acceleration and draw; Myriad Leaf Shower scaling attack)

card_list.name: Tapu Bulu
card_list.role: Single-Prize Heavy Attacker (Wood Hammer 220 dmg; bypasses ex-immunity walls like Crustle and breaks 2-prize trade)

card_list.name: Munkidori
card_list.role: Psychic Counter & Precision Damage Sniping (Adrena-Brain moves 30 damage counters with Dark energy; Psychic pressure vs Mega Lucario ex)

card_list.name: Fezandipiti ex
card_list.role: Hand Disruption Recovery Anchor (Flip the Script draws 3 cards on turn following friendly KO; counters Judge/Unfair Stamp)

card_list.name: Latias ex
card_list.role: Universal Mobility & Retreat Unlock Engine (Skyliner grants free retreat to all Basic Pokémon; neutralizes Boss trapping & Nighttime Mine)

card_list.name: Budew
card_list.role: Early Setup & Zero-Cost Stall Pivot (Searchable via Buddy-Buddy Poffin and Bug Catching Set; safe opening pivot)

card_list.name: Bug Catching Set
card_list.role: Grass Resource Filter & Accelerator (Looks top 7 cards for up to 2 Grass Pokémon and/or Basic Grass Energy)

card_list.name: Poké Pad
card_list.role: Trainer & Item Digging Engine (Deep deck digging to ensure unbroken chain of search and draw supporters)

card_list.name: Ultra Ball
card_list.role: Universal Pokémon Search & Discard Outlet (Searches any Pokémon while pruning hand and feeding Energy Retrieval/Night Stretcher)

card_list.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
card_list.role: Basic Bench Acceleration (Directly benches low-HP Basics such as Budew and Munkidori)

card_list.name: Night Stretcher
card_list.role: Targeted Discard Recursion (Recovers 1 Pokémon or 1 Basic Energy from discard directly to hand)

card_list.name: Energy Retrieval
card_list.role: Basic Energy Recycling (Returns 2 Basic Energies from discard to hand to immediately fuel Teal Dance attachments)

card_list.name: Switch
card_list.role: Active Repositioning & Status Reset (Switches Active Pokémon, clears special conditions, and provides redundancy with Skyliner)

card_list.name: Tera Orb
card_list.role: Direct Tera Search (Zero-discard search for Teal Mask Ogerpon ex)

card_list.name: Unfair Stamp
card_list.role: Dominant Disruption ACE SPEC (Shuffles opponent hand to 2 cards and refreshes user hand to 5 cards after a friendly KO)

card_list.name: Lillie's Determination
card_list.role: Premier Main Draw Engine (Shuffles hand and draws 6 cards, expanding to 8 cards when behind in prize cards)

card_list.name: Boss’s Orders
card_list.role: Tactical Gust & Win-Condition Target Execution (Forces opponent benched target into Active spot for decisive KOs)

card_list.name: Carmine
card_list.role: Turn 1 Fast Cycle & Going-First Acceleration (Playable on Turn 1 going first to discard hand and draw 5 new cards)

card_list.name: Judge
card_list.role: Symmetrical Hand Reset Disruption (Resets both players to 4 cards, destroying Alakazam Powerful Hand scaling)

card_list.name: Briar
card_list.role: Prize Acceleration Finisher (Allows Tera Pokémon attack to take 1 extra prize card when opponent has exactly 2 prizes remaining)

card_list.name: Battle Cage
card_list.role: Bench Damage Immunity & Anti-Spread Shield (Prevents damage counter placement on Benched Pokémon, neutralizing Dragapult ex)

card_list.name: Basic {G} Energy
card_list.role: Grass Turbo Fuel & Teal Dance Engine (Primary energy pool for manual attachment, Teal Dance acceleration, and Myriad Leaf Shower)

card_list.name: Basic {D} Energy
card_list.role: Adrena-Brain Darkness Trigger (Enables Munkidori Adrena-Brain ability to move 30 damage counters every turn)

card_list.name: Grow Grass Energy
card_list.role: HP Threshold & Resilience Boost (Provides {G} energy and +20 HP boost to Grass Pokémon)

turn_by_turn_attachment_expectations.turn_2_expected_total_attached_energies: 2.0 to 3.0 energies across active and bench
turn_by_turn_attachment_expectations.turn_3_plus_sustainability: Energy Retrieval (ID 1118 x2) and Night Stretcher (ID 1097 x3) provide continuous recycling of discarded Basic {G} and {D} energies for unbroken Teal Dance engine activation.

lb826_alakazam_seok.opponent_threat_vector: Powerful Hand attack dealing 20x damage per card in hand (up to 240-280+ for a single {P} energy), fueled by Kadabra/Alakazam evolution draws and Dudunsparce draw engine.
key_tactical_lines: Deploy Judge (ID 1213) and Unfair Stamp (ID 1080) to reset opponent hand to 4 and 2 cards respectively, collapsing Powerful Hand damage from 280 down to 40-80 dmg.
Use Boss's Orders (ID 1182) to eliminate low-HP Abra (50 HP) before evolution.
Activate Munkidori (ID 112) Adrena-Brain to move 30 damage counters over Battle Cage to snipe benched Abras without triggering attack damage barriers.
Fezandipiti ex (ID 140) triggers Flip the Script on any KO to maintain hand replenishment.

lb1009_945_mega_lucario_ex.opponent_threat_vector: 340 HP Mega Lucario ex (ID 678) dealing 270 damage via Mega Brave (boosted to 300+ with Premium Power Pro); Aura Jab accelerates 3 Fighting energy from discard; Carmine enables fast T1 setup.
key_tactical_lines: Exploit Mega Lucario ex 2x weakness to Psychic ({P}) using Munkidori (ID 112) Adrena-Brain damage redirection and Latias ex (ID 184) positioning.
Deploy Tapu Bulu (ID 920) Wood Hammer (220 dmg) as a 1-prize trading weapon, forcing Lucario to trade 2 prizes for 1.
Scale Teal Mask Ogerpon ex Myriad Leaf Shower (30 + 30 per energy on both actives) to hit 210+ damage against heavily energized Lucario.
Capitalize on Mega Brave consecutive attack restriction by using Switch (ID 1123) and Skyliner free retreat to maintain offensive tempo.

lb814_600_dragapult_crustle.archetype: Dragapult ex Spread / Crustle Immunity Wall
lb814_600_dragapult_crustle.opponent_threat_vector: Dragapult ex (ID 121) Phantom Dive (200 dmg + 60 bench counters) and Crustle (ID 345) Mysterious Rock Inn (complete damage immunity from Pokémon ex, stacking HP to 270 with Hero's Cape/Grow Grass).
lb814_600_dragapult_crustle.counter_strategy: Bench Counter Blockade & Non-ex Heavy Hitters
key_tactical_lines: Establish Battle Cage (ID 1264) to completely prevent damage counter placement on Benched Pokémon, neutralizing Phantom Dive secondary spread.
Deploy Tapu Bulu (ID 920) Wood Hammer (220 dmg) as a non-ex single-prize attacker, directly bypassing Crustle Mysterious Rock Inn ex-immunity for clean knockouts.
Use Munkidori (ID 112) Adrena-Brain to redirect accumulated active damage counters back onto opponent's Drakloak and Dreepy.
Briar (ID 1201) accelerates endgame prize acquisition against Dragapult ex.

first_sub_kaggle_2707.opponent_threat_vector: Stage 2 Alakazam line with Dudunsparce engine, Nighttime Mine retreat disruption, and Xerosic's Machinations hand control.
key_tactical_lines: Latias ex (ID 184) Skyliner grants 0 retreat cost to all Basic Pokémon, completely ignoring Nighttime Mine retreat taxes.
Execute Turn 2 full board setup via Bug Catching Set and Teal Dance while opponent is still evolving Basic Abra.
Unfair Stamp (ID 1080) punishes any mid-game KO by reducing opponent hand to 2 cards, disabling Powerful Hand burst.
Boss's Orders (ID 1182) gusts and eliminates Dudunsparce before Run Away Draw loops begin.

lb510_mega_abomasnow.archetype: Mega Abomasnow ex Tank Ramp / Heavy Mill
lb510_mega_abomasnow.opponent_threat_vector: 350 HP Mega Abomasnow ex (ID 723) executing Hammer-lanche (100x dmg per discarded {W} energy from top 6 cards) with 34 Water energy pool.
key_tactical_lines: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex Myriad Leaf Shower deals 30 + 30 per energy attached to both active Pokémon; against a 3-4 energy Abomasnow, Ogerpon hits for 240-300+ Grass damage.
Exploit 4-retreat cost on Mega Abomasnow by using Boss's Orders (ID 1182) to strand an unpowered bench Abomasnow in the Active Spot.
Accelerate opponent deckout: Abomasnow self-mills 6 cards per swing, burning through its library within 4-5 turns.

deck_633_baseline_yan.archetype: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex Grass Turbo Baseline (27.9% WR)
deck_633_baseline_yan.opponent_threat_vector: Mirror Teal Mask Ogerpon ex with 19 energies and Bug Catching Set.
deck_633_baseline_yan.counter_strategy: Setup Consistency Fix, Asymmetric Prize Trade & Briar Finisher
key_tactical_lines: Eliminate the 52.5% opening mulligan flaw of Deck #633 (which ran only 5 Basics) by fielding 11 Basics (P(Setup within 1 mulligan) = 95.05%).
Incorporate Tapu Bulu (ID 920) 1-prize attacker and Munkidori (ID 112) damage redistribution, establishing a favorable 7-prize clock against opponent pure 2-prize board.
Use Briar (ID 1201) on the final attack when opponent has 2 prizes remaining to take 3 prizes off an Ogerpon ex KO, closing out the match in 2 knockouts.
